narration.text: Defensive driving means watching for other road users' unlawful actions or mistakes and adjusting your own driving to prevent a crash. Following rules yourself does not remove the need to anticipate mistakes by drivers, pedestrians and bicyclists around you. After a collision, stop and, if feasible, move the vehicle clear of the road so traffic can pass the site. When a crash causes injuries, contact emergency assistance by calling nine-one-one. Provide assistance to injured people and arrange an ambulance, moving an injured person only when doing so is necessary. Compare each requirement separately before combining it with another. narration.text: The handbook describes no general mandatory-insurance-purchase law in New Hampshire, while explaining that an uninsured crash can create financial-responsibility requirements. A driver involved in an uninsured collision may be responsible for another person's property damage and medical expenses caused by the crash. If an uninsured driver cannot pay the resulting property and medical claims, DMV must suspend driving privileges until a settlement is reached under the manual's account. Compare each requirement separately before combining it with another. Preserve who the statement covers, the action it describes and any exception it states.

lines.text: After an uninsured accident, insurance proof may be required for several years through an SR-twenty-two
certificate filed by an insurer.

narration.text: After an uninsured accident, insurance proof may be required for several years through an SR-twenty-two certificate filed by an insurer. An impaired-driving conviction is among the offenses that can require SR-twenty-two insurance proof before driving and registration privileges are restored. Failing to stop and report an involved crash is another listed conviction requiring insurance proof for reinstatement. A homicide arising from operating a motor vehicle can trigger the stated insurance-proof requirement before reinstatement. Compare each requirement separately before combining it with another. Preserve who the statement covers, the action it describes and any exception it states.

lines.text: A second reckless-driving offense is listed among the convictions requiring proof of insurance for restoration
of privileges.

narration.text: A second reckless-driving offense is listed among the convictions requiring proof of insurance for restoration of privileges. A review of the driver's traffic-violation history at a just-cause hearing can also result in an insurance-proof requirement. Compare each requirement separately before combining it with another.
